summary: Implemented the engine-free feature without running tests or repository code, as instructed, and without committing. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver with save, save_batch, finalize, overwrite-false merge) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver with save, save_batch, private static _create_file_basename). Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Changed the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32. Refactored SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver (with an engine-accepting completion hook), and TensorBoardImageHandler (new index parameter) into thin adapters. Renamed output_path to output_dir in the sliding-window integration test and two segmentation examples. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Static checks only: no lines over 120 characters, no trailing whitespace, single trailing newlines, no leftover output_path references. Not verified: test execution and flake8 runs. Decisions to review: CSV merge skips blank rows; the segmentation examples now keep model output dtype by default, per the spec.
